title: The Editor of a Lifetime
summary: Perry Metzger, an Emacs user since 1983, gives a talk on why he has used one editor for decades. It mixes history, philosophy and speculation about Emacs's future, and teaches some Emacs fundamentals.
why: Mentioned in Emacs threads as a talk on long-term editor commitment and on Emacs's blocking limitations.

quote.text: Later I found a talk which expresses the same sentiment in it's title
